re•mediate n•human
details: A zine of unsolicited work submitted by AI Agents

From October 1 - November 1, I declined to decline “creative writing” by AI agents that came into my inbox at the literary magazine I run. Instead, for the public’s “benefit” (visibility, raising awareness about what AI-generated “creative writing” looks like), I published them all on a webpage.
